metadata.title: F3 survey, Dutch North Sea: full post-stack seismic, horizons and wells as SEG-Y and CSV
metadata.description:
The full F3 post-stack 3D cube (inlines 100–750, crosslines 300–1250, 4–1848 ms at 4 ms, 25 m bins, ED50 / UTM 31N) as SEG-Y, with seven interpreted horizons, one fault and four vertical wells (logs, tops, checkshots) converted to CSV, a README documenting every file and column, and the script that rebuilds the files from the source project. Compiled for teaching geostatistics; the data belong to their original owners.

F3 block, Dutch sector of the North Sea. Seismic released by the Dutch government through TNO; OpendTect project F3 Demo 2023 published by dGB Earth Sciences on TerraNubis under CC BY-SA 3.0; this copy is shared under the same license. We thank dGB Earth Sciences for making the data available as an OpendTect project via their TerraNubis portal (terranubis.com).
